text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has managed to leave quite
a mark
on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
And today, she's still—
Wooooo!
How's our next race, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I see. Good. I'm looking forward to
what's to
come.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What a great race, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was cheering with all
my might.
But in the next race...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Not so fast! It's gonna be a one-on-one with me! And I'm gonna come out on top!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
W-wow! What a great lineup! Hurry, get
the
camera!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Brian! Who are you racing next?!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
...I guess this is what it means to be a
victim of
your own success.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Whatever. I don't care who's next. I'll
take on
anyone.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well then...
Might I have the privilege of competing against you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Симболи Рудольф?!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
How about it, Brian? Do you accept my

challenge?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Is it okay with you, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Hurry and call the editorial
department!
We've got more interesting
news regarding Narita
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Brian! We'd love to hear about your
future goals!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text: ...Haha.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
As always, she's the center of
excitement.
